post.description:
:::warning
This is the new version of the API documentation; for the old version of the API, please see [https://docs.kie.ai/old-model/veo3-api/get-veo-3-4k-video](https://docs.kie.ai/old-model/veo3-api/get-veo-3-4k-video).
:::
::: info[]
  Get the ultra-high-definition 4K version of a Veo 3.1 video generation task.
:::


### Usage Instructions

* **Supported aspect ratios**
  * Both **16:9** and **9:16** tasks support upgrading to **1080P** and **4K**.
* **Processing time**
  * 4K generation requires significant extra processing time — typically **~5–10 minutes** depending on load.
* If the 4K video is not ready yet, the endpoint may return a non-200 code. Wait and retry (recommended interval: **30s+**) until the result is available.

::: tip[]
  For production use, we recommend using `callBackUrl` to receive automatic notifications when 4K generation completes, rather than polling frequently.
:::

:::tip
Choosing 1080p or 4k at generation costs the 720p price plus the 1080P / 4K upgrade price. For current prices, see [kie.ai/pricing](https://kie.ai/pricing).
:::

## Callbacks

After submitting a 4K video generation task, use the unified callback mechanism to receive generation completion notifications:

<Card title="4K Video Generation Callbacks" icon="bell" href="/veo3-api/get-veo-3-4k-video-callbacks">
  Learn how to configure and handle 4K video generation callback notifications
</Card>


## Error Responses

When submitting repeated requests for the same task ID, the system returns a `422` status code with specific error details:

<Tabs>
  <TabItem value="processing" label="4K Video Processing">
    ```json
    {
      "code": 422,
      "msg": "4k is processing. It should be ready in 5-10 minutes. Please check back shortly.",
      "data": {
        "taskId": "veo_task_example123",
        "resultUrls": null,
        "imageUrls": null
      }
    }
    ```
  </TabItem>
  <TabItem value="generated" label="4K Video Already Generated">
    ```json
    {
      "code": 422,
      "msg": "The video has been generated successfully",
      "data": {
        "taskId": "veo_task_example123",
        "resultUrls": [
          "https://tempfile.aiquickdraw.com/v/example_task_1234567890.mp4"
        ],
        "imageUrls": [
          "https://tempfile.aiquickdraw.com/v/example_task_1234567890.jpg"
        ]
      }
    }
    ```
  </TabItem>
</Tabs>

callBackUrl.description:
The URL to receive 4K video generation task completion updates. Optional but recommended for production use.

- System will POST task status and results to this URL when 4K video generation completes
- Callback includes generated video URLs, media IDs, and related information
- Your callback endpoint should accept POST requests with JSON payload containing results
- Alternatively, poll Get Task Details (/market/common/get-task-detail).
- To ensure callback security, see [Webhook Verification Guide](/common-api/webhook-verification) for signature verification implementation

code.description: Status code of the request. The HTTP status is 200 even when the request fails, so always check this field: 200 means success; any other value means the request failed and msg describes the reason. Common values: 401 invalid or missing API key; 402 insufficient credits; 429 rate limit exceeded; 422 or 500 the request could not be processed (read msg and check your parameters before retrying). If taskId does not exist or the source task failed, the request returns a non-200 code; retrying will not help.

taskId.description: Task ID, can be used with [Get Task Details](/market/common/get-task-detail) endpoint to query task status

imageUrls.description: Related thumbnail or preview image URLs

post.description: When the 4K video generation task completes, the system will send a POST request to your configured callback URL

code.description:
Status code

- **200**: Success - 4K video generation task successful

Response status code

- **200**: Success - Request has been processed successfully
- **401**: Unauthorized - Authentication credentials are missing or invalid
- **402**: Insufficient Credits - Account does not have enough credits to perform the operation
- **404**: Not Found - The requested resource or endpoint does not exist
- **408**: Timeout - No result has been returned for over 10 minutes.
- **422**: Validation Error - The request parameters failed validation checks
- **429**: Rate Limited - Request limit has been exceeded for this resource
- **455**: Service Unavailable - System is currently undergoing maintenance
- **500**: Server Error - An unexpected error occurred while processing the request
- **501**: Generation Failed - Content generation task failed
- **505**: Feature Disabled - The requested feature is currently disabled

msg.description: Response message, error description when failed

value.msg: Server Error - An unexpected error occurred while processing the request

BearerAuth.description: All API requests require a Bearer Token. Add the header `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` to authenticate requests.
